params.name: orgID
params.description: The org ID

params.name: compoundName
params.description: A compound's name

params.name: polyglot_scan
params.description: Polyglot scan ID to filter to; defaults to the latest scan.

params.name: scan_version
params.description: The version of the code at scan time. Ignored if polyglot_scan is given.

params.name: scan_branch
params.description: The code branch at scan time. Ignored if polygot_scan or scan_version are given.

params.name: scan_tag
params.description: Tags passed to the analyzer at scan time. Ignored if polygot_scan, scan_version, or scan_branch are given.

params.name: scan_platform
params.description: The analysis platform. Cannot be specified together with scan_language.

params.name: scan_language
params.description: The analysis language. Cannot be specified together with scan_platform.

params.name: counts_exclude
params.description: The tags to exclude from 'counts' in the response. Can be specified more than once. The default filters out a small set of tags that don't add too much value in the kind of aggregate that 'counts' contains. An empty value resets the list.

params.name: finding_type
params.description: Only list findings of the given type. Can be specified multiple times.

params.name: finding_status
params.description: Only list findings with the given status. Can be specified multiple times.

params.name: finding_assignee
params.description: Only list findings with the given assignee. Cannot be specified together with finding_assignment.

params.name: finding_assignment
params.description: Only list findings of the given assignment state.

params.name: finding_tag
params.description: Only list findings matching the given tag query. Can be specified up to 20 times. A finding will match a series of tag queries if it matches all of them.

params.name: finding_search
params.description: Only list findings containing the given value (under simple Unicode case-folding) in their title or description. Can be specified up to 5 times.  A finding will match a series of searches if it matches all of them.

params.name: finding_reachable
params.description: Only list reachable findings.

params.name: finding_exploitable
params.description: Only list exploitable findings.

params.name: finding_has_ai_fix
params.description: Only list findings with an AI fix available.

params.name: finding_sort
params.description:
The field used to sort results.
If not given, the default is to sort by ID in descending order. When given, sort by that criterion, defaulting to ascending order.

params.name: finding_order
params.description: How results are sorted. See the note on finding_sort for defaults.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to fetch. Only the findings portion of the response is paginated; counts and scans are present every time.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page; defaults to 50

params.name: finding_fields
params.description: Specifies the fields included or excluded in the findings in the response. Can be specified more than once.
